meta.name: render-flatlay
meta.description: Render the FREE steps of the flatlay-product-reveal video format — composite each flat product cover onto the dressed tabletop plate to make the Veo start frames (build_start_frames), speed-and-hard-cut concat the i2v beats plus the HTML end card and mux the music (build_master), and screenshot the brand end-card HTML to a static-dwell clip (render_endcard). Deterministic, FREE (Playwright + PIL + FFmpeg), no paid calls, product covers and end-card text stay pixel-crisp. The paid steps (flat covers, Veo beats, music) are separate capabilities; the recipe orchestrates them. Use for the flatlay-product-reveal format.
